newsitem.title: FINLAND: Sampo up on share split, asset value/shr.
newsitem.headline: Sampo up on share split, asset value/shr.

text.p: Shares in Finnish insurance group Vakuutusosakeyhtio Sampo rose in active trade on Wednesday, buoyed by a plan for a four-for-one share split and by its 1996 net asset value per share, brokers said.
At 1550/1350 GMT, Sampo traded at 465.00 markka, up 10.00 markka or more than two percent, after touching 470.00 markka. Trade amounted to 29 million markka, which is active for Sampo.
"Sampo's 1996 earnings were good, but I expect that the main reason for today's rise is the share split announcement," one broker said.
Sampo's 1996 report showed a 619 million markka operating profit, up from 319 million in 1995.
Some brokers said Sampo also gained to match its net asset value per share.
At end-1996, Sampo's net asset value per share was 477 markka, up from 392 markka a year earlier.
